feed.subtitle: June Sungjoo Kim is a Seoul-based Biosystems Engineering & AI undergraduate at Seoul National University (SNU) (class of 2027). He is currently a research assistant in SNU's RLLAB, exploring Flow-Matching trajectory generation for offline RL, and a software engineer building accessibility apps for the visually impaired. His work spans robotic perception, on-device / edge AI, and bootstrapping tech startups that solve everyday problems for pets and people.
